mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BID_CASES WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId}
SELECT BID_CASE_ID, GROUP_VER, PENDING_REQ_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM BID_ASSIGN_CASE WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_ASSIGN_CASE (BID_CASE_ID, GROUP_VER, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, 1, #{by}, #{now}, #{by}, #{now})
INSERT INTO BID_ASSIGNMENT (BID_CASE_ID, EMP_NO, ACTIVE_YN, ASSIGNED_BY, ASSIGNED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{empNo}, 1, #{by}, #{now})

INSERT INTO BID_ASSIGN_LOG (BID_CASE_ID, ACTION_CD, TARGET_EMP_NO, REQ_ID, REASON, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, LOGGED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{actionCd}, #{targetEmpNo}, #{reqId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actorEmpNo}, #{verified}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT a.EMP_NO, u.NAME, u.POSITION_TITLE, a.ASSIGNED_AT FROM BID_ASSIGNMENT a LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = a.EMP_NO WHERE a.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND a.ACTIVE_YN = 1 ORDER BY a.ASSIGNED_AT, a.EMP_NO

SELECT l.ACTION_CD, c.CODE_NAME AS ACTION_NAME, l.TARGET_EMP_NO, t.NAME AS TARGET_NAME, l.REQ_ID, l.REASON, l.ACTOR_EMP_NO, ac.NAME AS ACTOR_NAME, l.EMP_VERIFIED, l.LOGGED_AT FROM BID_ASSIGN_LOG l LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE c ON c.CODE_GROUP = 'ASSIGN_ACTION' AND c.CODE = l.ACTION_CD LEFT JOIN USERS t ON t.EMP_NO = l.TARGET_EMP_NO LEFT JOIN USERS ac ON ac.EMP_NO = l.ACTOR_EMP_NO WHERE l.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} ORDER BY l.LOG_ID
SELECT BID_CASE_ID, ASSIGNED_AT FROM BID_ASSIGNMENT WHERE EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND ACTIVE_YN = 1 ORDER BY ASSIGNED_AT DESC, BID_CASE_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BID_ASSIGNMENT WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND ACTIVE_YN = 1
